title: Family: one model, one task, one I/O contract
description: Everything that is true of every entry in the family. An entry may not change any of it: two entries of a family differ only in how the same computation is spelled for a different configuration, so they are interchangeable to a caller. Change the contract and it is a different family.

task.description: e.g. "text-to-image". Free text: a taxonomy would be a selection mechanism.

model.description: Hugging Face id of the model the graphs were built from, e.g. "stabilityai/sd-turbo".

revision.description: The revision the weights were exported from. null when it was not recorded, which is a gap, not a licence.

components.description: Other checkpoints folded into the graphs, e.g. a decoder.

contract.description: What a caller hands in and what comes back, for every entry of the family. Shapes and dtypes here are the promise; an entry's graphs must match it.

chaining.description: How the graphs are wired to each other on device, in prose plus the ordered steps.

scheduler.description: For a diffusion family: which scheduler the in-graph step implements, and the constants it was baked with.

tokenizer.description: Data, plus the algorithm that reads it. The files are in the family directory because every entry shares them.

algorithm.description: e.g. "CLIP BPE". This is the contract; the .js next to it is one implementation.

module.description: Reference implementation shipped with the family, if any.

parity.description: What it was checked against, and with what result.

constants.description: Where the constants blobs live in the family's structure. The v2 direction is ONE canonical blob set per family that every entry indexes; today entries carry their own, and this records which.

scope.description: per-entry: each entry's manifest.json names its own blobs. per-family: entries index the blobs named here.

canonical.description: Present only when scope is per-family.

verification.description: The reference case every entry of this family is checked against. The bars may differ per entry (a lossy variant cannot meet an exact one's), but the case does not.

source.description: Where a caller gets this value from.
